title: Vegan Three-Course Budget Challenge: $20 vs $200 (Goodful)
summary: In this Goodful video, hosts Coco and Lala tackle a vegan three-course meal on a tight budget, each working within a distinct limit ($200 for one, $20 for the other) and documenting how far a plant-based menu can stretch when money is tight. The walkthrough captures planning (“three-course meal on a budget”), appetizer prep with a hummus and grilled-vegetable tray, a pasta-forward entrée centered on morel mushrooms with a butter–Chardonnay style sauce, and a dessert built around pistachios, dates, granola, and lemon sorbet. The segment includes practical techniques like microwaving green beans, grilling vegetables, and layering flavors with affordable pantry staples (brown sugar, vegan butter, garlic salt, and cinnamon), as well as the hosts’ reflections on health and wellness as part of cooking. The video progresses from budgeting and planning to prep, plating, and taste-testing, offering concrete, repeatable ideas for affordable vegan dining with vivid plating and flavor contrasts.

sections.title: Appetizer: Hummus with grilled veggies and olives
concepts: presentation of an appetizer on a budget
sections.description: Discussion and execution of an inexpensive appetizer: a hummus tray with roasted/grilled vegetables, olives, and naan, including a quick note about flavor components and a teaser of a simple, accessible seasoning approach.

sections.title: Entree: Butter Chardonnay sauce, morel mushrooms, and pineapple in jambalaya rice
sections.description: Preparation and plating of the main course featuring a butter Chardonnay-style sauce, the premium ingredient of morel mushrooms, and a pineapple element folded into jambalaya rice to balance spice with sweetness, all rendered with vegan ingredients on a tight budget.

sections.title: Dessert: Pistachio-date crust with lemon sorbet and granola topping
sections.description: Dessert assembly featuring a crust made from pistachios and dates, lemon sorbet, apricot accents, and a granola topping, finished in the oven to achieve a crunchy texture. The segment includes tasting commentary and reactions on texture and sweetness.
